SELECT major, MIN(first_source_position) AS first_source_position
         FROM (SELECT * FROM course_filter_facets WHERE (semester IS NOT 'HK2_2026_2027' OR is_user_added=1 OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM hk2_catalogue_publications p
  JOIN hk2_catalogue_publication_receipts r ON r.id=p.receipt_id
  WHERE p.semester='HK2_2026_2027' AND p.state='OPEN' AND p.revision=1
    AND p.manifest_sha256='2fe8af0743805fcc64ba414e22817fb26f3b5ce2247b50677bc518122c36e212' AND p.payload_sha256='2d328a92c048d2869e49cf7abd078f1b9ee44afb4005e00cbdbf78d6a24f1797'
    AND p.official_count=2357 AND p.batch_count=95
    AND length(p.verification_sha256)=64 AND p.verification_sha256=r.verification_sha256
    AND r.action='OPEN_HK2_2026_2027' AND r.owner_id=252552483 AND r.owner_comment_id>0
    AND length(r.backup_restore_sha256)=64 AND length(r.release_sha)=40
    AND p.opened_at=r.created_at
    AND (SELECT json_group_array(json_array(actor_scope,actor_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,operation,response_json,created_at))
      FROM (SELECT * FROM course_mutation_receipts WHERE actor_id='hk2-bulk-v1' ORDER BY actor_scope,idempotency_key)) IS r.import_ledger_json
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_schedules hc WHERE hc.semester='HK2_2026_2027'
      AND hc.is_user_added IS NOT 1)=2357
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_schedules hc WHERE hc.semester='HK2_2026_2027'
      AND hc.is_user_added IS NOT 1 AND hc.catalogue_visibility='published')=2357
))) AS course_filter_facets WHERE semester IN (?)
        GROUP BY major
        ORDER BY first_source_position

SELECT id, semester, course_code, subject_name, credits, phase, day_of_week, shift, weeks, room, campus, instructor, group_name, cohort, major, academic_program, is_user_added, source_position
         FROM (SELECT * FROM course_schedules WHERE (semester IS NOT 'HK2_2026_2027' OR is_user_added=1 OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM hk2_catalogue_publications p
  JOIN hk2_catalogue_publication_receipts r ON r.id=p.receipt_id
  WHERE p.semester='HK2_2026_2027' AND p.state='OPEN' AND p.revision=1
    AND p.manifest_sha256='2fe8af0743805fcc64ba414e22817fb26f3b5ce2247b50677bc518122c36e212' AND p.payload_sha256='2d328a92c048d2869e49cf7abd078f1b9ee44afb4005e00cbdbf78d6a24f1797'
    AND p.official_count=2357 AND p.batch_count=95
    AND length(p.verification_sha256)=64 AND p.verification_sha256=r.verification_sha256
    AND r.action='OPEN_HK2_2026_2027' AND r.owner_id=252552483 AND r.owner_comment_id>0
    AND length(r.backup_restore_sha256)=64 AND length(r.release_sha)=40
    AND p.opened_at=r.created_at
    AND (SELECT json_group_array(json_array(actor_scope,actor_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,operation,response_json,created_at))
      FROM (SELECT * FROM course_mutation_receipts WHERE actor_id='hk2-bulk-v1' ORDER BY actor_scope,idempotency_key)) IS r.import_ledger_json
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_schedules hc WHERE hc.semester='HK2_2026_2027'
      AND hc.is_user_added IS NOT 1)=2357
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_schedules hc WHERE hc.semester='HK2_2026_2027'
      AND hc.is_user_added IS NOT 1 AND hc.catalogue_visibility='published')=2357
))) AS course_schedules WHERE catalogue_visibility = 'published' AND semester IN (?)
         ORDER BY source_position ASC, id ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT p.semester,p.state,p.revision,p.manifest_sha256,p.payload_sha256,
      p.official_count,p.batch_count,p.verification_sha256,p.opened_at,r.action,r.owner_id,
      r.owner_comment_id,r.verification_sha256,r.backup_restore_sha256,r.release_sha,r.import_ledger_json,r.created_at,
      l.actor_scope,l.actor_id,l.idempotency_key,l.request_hash,l.operation,l.response_json,l.created_at
      FROM hk2_catalogue_publications p
      LEFT JOIN hk2_catalogue_publication_receipts r ON r.id=p.receipt_id
      LEFT JOIN course_mutation_receipts l ON 0
      WHERE p.semester='HK2_2026_2027'

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(general_class) AS class_name
    FROM student_directory WHERE general_class IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(general_class) <> ''
    ORDER BY class_name COLLATE NOCASE
